title: Leap of Faith
description: is_leap(year) returns True for leap years: divisible by 4, except years divisible by 100, unless they are also divisible by 400.
code:
def is_leap(year):
    return year % 4 == 0 and year % 100 != 0
solution:
def is_leap(year):
    return (year % 4 == 0 and year % 100 != 0) or year % 400 == 0
hint: Read the rule again, especially the last part. What about the year 2000?
explanation: The code covers "divisible by 4" and "except by 100" but forgets "unless by 400". So 2000 is wrongly rejected. The fix adds `or year % 400 == 0`. Bugs often hide in the last clause of a spec.
